adjudicated.title: No Human Approval for Destructive Actions
adjudicated.description:
Agent 'agent' has 2 tool(s) capable of destructive actions (create_file, delete_file) but no human-in-the-loop approval configured.
The agent can autonomously execute, write, or delete without confirmation.
adjudicated.reason: suite exposes destructive/egress tools without a tool-level approval gate (sinks incl. ['delete_email', 'delete_file', 'send_email'])

adjudicated.title: Execution Without Telemetry/Monitoring
adjudicated.description:
Agent 'agent' has high-risk capabilities (send_email, delete_email, get_unread_emails, get_sent_emails, get_received_emails) but no logging, telemetry, or monitoring is configured.

Without monitoring, malicious or anomalous agent behavior can continue undetected for extended periods. In the OpenAI Galaxy incident (July 2026), a model operated unmonitored for 4 days, executing 17,000+ actions before detection.

adjudicated.title: Information-Flow Exfiltration Path → 'send_email'
adjudicated.description:
Lethal trifecta detected: untrusted input can control the egress tool 'send_email' while internal/sensitive data flows to it, creating a provable exfiltration path.

Control path (attacker steers the sink):
  get_unread_emails → __llm__ → send_email

Data path (sensitive data reaches the payload):
  create_file → __llm__ → send_email

Subsumes (same read→egress root cause, linked for context): AG-002 (Data Exfiltration Path); AG-COMP (Compositional Risk: Lateral Movement: Network + Multiple Data Sources); AG-TRIFECTA (Information-Flow Exfiltration Path → 'add_calendar_event_participants'); AG-TRIFECTA (Information-Flow Exfiltration Path → 'cancel_calendar_event'); AG-TRIFECTA (Information-Flow Exfiltration Path → 'create_file'); AG-TRIFECTA (Information-Flow Exfiltration Path → 'delete_file'); AG-TRIFECTA (Information-Flow Exfiltration Path → 'reschedule_calendar_event')
